gloss: to be hungry; to get hungry (casual)

definitions.gloss: to be hungry; to get hungry
definitions.explanation: A casual, direct expression meaning to feel hungry. Literally 'stomach diminishes.' More blunt and masculine-leaning than the polite form.

examples.japanese: もう{腹|はら}{減|へ}ったから{早|はや}く{食|た}べよう。
examples.english: I'm already hungry, so let's eat soon.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}から{何|なに}も{食|た}べてないから{腹|はら}が{減|へ}って{仕方|しかた}がない。
examples.english: I haven't eaten anything since morning, so I'm starving.

notes:
A casual way to say 'I'm hungry,' typically used in informal conversation. The past tense {腹|はら}{減|へ}った is the most common form. Often used without the particle が between {腹|はら} and {減|へ}る in very casual speech, though {腹|はら}が{減|へ}る is the grammatically complete form.

REGISTER:
Casual and somewhat rough. More common in male speech and among close friends. Women and speakers in polite contexts tend to prefer {お腹|なか}が{空|す}いた or {お腹|なか}が{空|す}きました.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腹|はら}{減|へ}った: I'm hungry (most common form)
- {腹|はら}が{減|へ}って{仕方|しかた}がない: to be starving; unbearably hungry
- {腹|はら}が{減|へ}っては{戦|いくさ}はできぬ: you can't fight on an empty stomach (proverb)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {お腹|なか}が{空|す}く: to be hungry — polite, gender-neutral
- {空腹|くうふく}: hunger — formal noun form
